finding.text: Deliverable 6's live proof was never run: `proof.mjs` is in the diff, but `task.jsonl` has no result line (no PASS/FAIL, no place count), and the session ended "without landing". Run `sessions-wake/proof.mjs` in the voice-wake worktree and log its JSON output before merging. The unit half does pass: `node Servex/agents/Sessions.test.mjs` gives 21 checks passed, run by this reviewer.

`say()` and `hold()` choose the message shape from `this.voice_seat()`, the process-wide switch, but `heard()` drops the reply only when `s.fast_seat === "voice"`, which is set per session (Sessions.js ~859/1005 vs ~1240). If an agent from the old seat is still awake when the switch flips, it gets the voice-shaped prompt and its reply is still posted as chat. Using one test for all three would be simpler.

The voice spec leaves out `mcp_url: ""`, so the agent loads the whole Servex door (100+ tool schemas) next to `local.item`, on every per-sentence low-effort turn (Sessions.js ~1084). If it only needs `mcp__local__item`, an `allowed_tools` list or `mcp_url: ""` would keep it as lean as session-fast was. This may need `local` to stay attached on its own, so check Agents.js ~1110.
`voice_seat(s)` is called with an argument at Sessions.js ~340 but is defined with none (~363). It is harmless, but it reads as though the switch were per session, and it is not.
`last_owner_text()` stays as a wrapper, and nothing in the diff calls it any more (Sessions.js ~360). Remove it unless something outside the fence uses it.
